narr: A storm system moving through the lower Great Lakes region triggered isolated thunderstorms over the Central Southern Tier of NY. A saturated atmosphere helped to support torrential rainfall over Steuben county which led to some flooding and washouts of local roads.
ev: Flash flooding washed a bridge out over Red Spring Run.
Flooding was reported on County Route 119.
Flooding of several roads and streets was reported around the intersection of State Route 36 and County Route 21.
